prompt: The camera does not move. Brandon turns the chrome valve a quarter turn with the spanner, then stops and looks at the pipe. Later he lifts one thumb in the air and his eyes crinkle. The overhead strip light hums. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Metal on metal, a faint tick of pipework, torch beam clicking, a quiet pleased exhale through the nose. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.
